dedupe_keys.name: new zealand 8m nationwide hydrologically conditioned dem and hydraulic roughness map

description: Earth Sciences New Zealand and NIWA publish an 8 m elevation and hydraulic-roughness dataset for freshwater flood modelling. Its coverage includes New Zealand’s North, South and Rakiura islands and extends at least 20 km offshore. The repository describes 526 tiles measuring 30 km by 30 km, with NetCDF layers for conditioned elevation, roughness, source category and LiDAR provenance. The current file listing separates these layers into four TAR archives and provides a GeoPackage tile index. GeoFabrics combines LiDAR and bathymetry, opens mapped culverts and waterways, and preserves stopbank crest elevations. The 2025 release is a static composite of surveys from different dates. Access is open and free under CC-BY-SA-4.0. A limitation is that estimated channel beds and heterogeneous source surveys introduce local uncertainty; repository and article counts of conditioning features also differ. No archive was downloaded. Modellers could use the layers to build flood meshes and test drainage or defence scenarios. They complement general terrain products by explicitly representing hydraulic pathways and roughness.
